title: Gemini has a billion monthly users. ChatGPT hit that in June and moved the goalposts
excerpt: Gemini passed a billion monthly users. ChatGPT reached that in June and a billion WEEKLY users in July. Gemini is a metric behind, not level.
content_html:
Sundar Pichai announced on Tuesday that the Gemini app had passed a billion monthly users. He called it “our fastest growing product ever” and the 14th Google product to hit the mark, alongside Search, Gmail, Android, Maps, Chrome, Play and YouTube. His post has been seen more than 1.5 million times.

Google published the engagement figures on its own blog the same day. Most coverage framed the milestone as Gemini closing the gap with ChatGPT. Check the metrics and they do not say that.

A monthly billion and a weekly billion are different animals

ChatGPT reached a billion monthly users on 3 June, which we reported as the fastest any app had got there. Gemini reached the same mark on 11 August. That is ten weeks later, on the identical measure.

OpenAI has now said so on the record. Spokesperson Lindsay McCallum told The Verge that ChatGPT “crossed 1 billion monthly users some time ago, and hit a billion a week in July”. She declined to say how many monthly users it has today.

We reported OpenAI passing a billion weekly users in late July, a target it had missed by about seven months. Weekly actives are a much harder test than monthly ones, because they count habit rather than curiosity. Gemini matched in August what ChatGPT did in June, and ChatGPT moved to a harder measure in between.

The counterweight is that ChatGPT has slowed

That reading has a hole in it and The Verge found it. ChatGPT was on 900 million weekly users in February. It took five months to add the last hundred million. Google is accelerating into the same wall that OpenAI has already hit.

The two curves matter more than either milestone. Gemini added 50 million users in a fortnight. ChatGPT added a hundred million in five months. The metrics differ, so the comparison is rough, but the direction is not really in doubt.

What a billion users actually counts

The measure is narrower than it sounds. It counts people who open the Gemini app or the web interface, and nothing else. Ars Technica noted that anyone who used Gemini “only once in the past month” sits inside the total.

The figure also excludes the places where most people meet Gemini. Google’s AI Mode in Search separately passed a billion monthly users, TechCrunch reports. The model runs inside Gmail, Docs and Android too. Tuesday’s number is the standalone app on its own.

The growth is real, and so is the distribution

None of that makes the climb unimpressive. Gemini was on 400 million monthly users in May 2025, 9to5Google notes, and Google announced 750 million in February. It reported more than 950 million on its Q2 earnings call a fortnight ago. Daily active users have tripled in a year.

The caveat is where those people came from. Gemini rides Android, Search, Chrome and Workspace, four products that already had a billion users each. ChatGPT had to be sought out. Comparing the two as though they started level flatters Google.

One figure cuts against that, and it is the strongest number Google released. Gemini has more than 100 million active users on iOS, where Google owns no distribution at all. Those people went and got it. Google adds that macOS users prompt it about twice as often as users on other surfaces.

What a billion people are actually doing

Gemini now generates more than 150 million images a day, each one watermarked with SynthID. About 63% of users talk to it rather than type. Google says parents are 43% more likely than other users to use voice for daily tasks.

One Gemini Live interaction in five now carries a live camera feed or a shared screen. Some 38% of school-related requests arrive with an attachment. On Android the app automates actions across more than 40 apps. That is an assistant rather than a chat window, and it is a different product from the one OpenAI built.

The number Google did not put in the post

A billion monthly users of a general assistant means a billion people getting answers that used to arrive as links. Google has spent a year defending AI Overviews against publishers over exactly that. Our own reporting tracked what it did to publisher traffic.

Gemini is the same trade at a larger scale and with no blue links at the bottom. Google has not published a figure for how many Gemini answers send anyone anywhere. That absence is not an oversight.

The product underneath is not settled

User numbers and model quality are separate problems, and Google is winning one of them. In July we reported that the next Gemini Pro had slipped by months after its coding fell short of internal targets. It was promised for June and has still not arrived. Google says it remains in testing.

The company has already started training Gemini 4, whose new boss was named the same week two of Gemini’s co-leads walked out. Demis Hassabis stepped back from running DeepMind on 5 August. Google hit the milestone six days after handing its AI division to someone else.

That combination is unusual and worth stating plainly. Distribution is solving the adoption problem faster than research is solving the capability one.

What to watch

The next honest comparison is a weekly figure. If Google publishes Gemini weekly actives near a billion, the parity framing everyone used this week becomes true. If Google keeps quoting monthly while OpenAI quotes weekly, that silence is the answer.

The second thing to watch is what Gemini does to the open web at this scale. A billion monthly users is roughly one in eight people alive. Google has crossed a threshold. From here it gets measured against that number rather than congratulated for it.

content_html_zh:
桑德尔·皮查伊 (Sundar Pichai) 周二宣布，Gemini 应用程序的月用户数已突破 10 亿。 他称其为“我们有史以来增长最快的产品”，也是第 14 个达到目标的 Google 产品，与搜索、Gmail、Android、地图、Chrome、Play 和 YouTube 并列。 他的帖子浏览量已超过 150 万次。

谷歌当天在自己的博客上发布了参与度数据。 大多数报道都将这一里程碑描述为 Gemini 缩小了与 ChatGPT 的差距。 检查指标，他们没有这么说。

每月十亿和每周十亿是不同的动物

ChatGPT 于 6 月 3 日达到每月 10 亿用户，据我们报道，这是所有应用程序达到这一目标的最快速度。 双子座在 8 月 11 日也达到了同样的水平。 那是十周后，以同样的标准。

OpenAI 现在已经公开这么说了。 发言人 Lindsay McCallum 告诉 The Verge，ChatGPT“不久前月用户数已突破 10 亿，7 月份每周用户数突破 10 亿”。 她拒绝透露目前每月有多少用户。

据我们报道，OpenAI 在 7 月下旬每周用户突破 10 亿，该目标已经落后了大约 7 个月。 每周的活动比每月的活动更难，因为它衡量的是习惯而不是好奇心。 Gemini 在 8 月份的表现与 ChatGPT 在 6 月份的表现相当，而 ChatGPT 在这之间采取了更严格的措施。

制衡因素是 ChatGPT 已经放慢了速度

这篇文章有一个漏洞，The Verge 发现了它。 二月份，ChatGPT 每周有 9 亿用户。 最后一个亿的增加，用了五个月的时间。 谷歌正在加速撞向 OpenAI 已经遇到的同一堵墙。

这两条曲线比任何一个里程碑都更重要。 Gemini 在两周内增加了 5000 万用户。 ChatGPT 在五个月内增加了一个亿。 指标不同，因此比较很粗糙，但方向确实没有疑问。

十亿用户实际上意味着什么

该措施比听起来更窄。 它只统计打开 Gemini 应用程序或 Web 界面的人数，仅统计其他内容。 Ars Technica 指出，任何“过去一个月内仅使用过一次”Gemini 的人都在总数之内。

这个数字还排除了大多数人遇见双子座的地方。 据 TechCrunch 报道，谷歌搜索中的人工智能模式月用户数已突破 10 亿。 该模型也在 Gmail、Docs 和 Android 中运行。 周二的数字是独立的应用程序。

增长是真实的，分布也是真实的

所有这些都不会让这次攀登变得不那么令人印象深刻。 9to5Google 指出，到 2025 年 5 月，Gemini 的月用户数为 4 亿，而谷歌在 2 月份宣布月用户数为 7.5 亿。 两周前，该公司在第二季度财报电话会议上公布了超过 9.5 亿美元的营收。 每日活跃用户在一年内增加了两倍。

需要注意的是这些人来自哪里。 Gemini 使用 Android、Search、Chrome 和 Workspace，这四款产品均已拥有 10 亿用户。 必须找到 ChatGPT。 比较两者就好像他们开始对谷歌进行奉承一样。

一个数字与此相反，这是谷歌发布的最强劲的数字。 Gemini 在 iOS 上拥有超过 1 亿活跃用户，而 Google 根本没有拥有任何发行版。 那些人就去拿了。 谷歌补充说，macOS 用户提示它的频率大约是其他平台上用户的两倍。

十亿人实际上在做什么

Gemini 现在每天生成超过 1.5 亿张图像，每张图像都带有 SynthID 水印。 大约 63% 的用户通过对话而不是打字。 谷歌表示，父母使用语音完成日常任务的可能性比其他用户高出 43%。

现在，五分之一的 Gemini Live 互动带有实时摄像头或共享屏幕。 大约 38% 的学校相关请求带有附件。 在 Android 上，该应用程序可以自动执行 40 多个应用程序的操作。 这是一个助手，而不是聊天窗口，它与 OpenAI 构建的产品不同。

Google 没有在帖子中添加该号码

总助理的每月 10 亿用户意味着 10 亿人获得了过去以链接形式到达的答案。 正是因为这个问题，谷歌花了一年的时间来为出版商辩护 AI Overviews。 我们自己的报告跟踪了它对发布商流量的影响。

双子座是规模更大的相同交易，底部没有蓝色链接。 谷歌尚未公布有多少双子座答案将任何人发送到任何地方的数据。 这种缺席并不是疏忽。

下面的产品尚未解决

用户数量和模型质量是不同的问题，而谷歌正在赢得其中之一。 7 月，我们报道称，下一代 Gemini Pro 在其编码未达到内部目标后，进度下滑了几个月。 本来答应六月份的，现在还没到。 谷歌表示仍在测试中。

该公司已经开始培训 Gemini 4，其新老板在 Gemini 的两位联合领导离职的同一周被任命。 Demis Hassabis 于 8 月 5 日退出 DeepMind 的运营。 谷歌在将人工智能部门交给其他人六天后就达到了这一里程碑。

这种组合很不寻常，值得明确说明。 分发解决采用问题的速度比研究解决能力问题的速度要快。

看什么

下一个诚实的比较是每周的数据。 如果 Google 公布 Gemini 每周的活跃量接近 10 亿，那么本周每个人使用的平价框架就成为现实。 如果 Google 继续每月报价，而 OpenAI 每周报价，那么沉默就是答案。

第二件值得关注的事情是 Gemini 对如此规模的开放网络所做的事情。 每月十亿用户大约相当于八分之一的活着的人。 谷歌已经跨过了一个门槛。 从这里开始，我们会根据这个数字来衡量它，而不是为此表示祝贺。
